Karen: Spain or Portugal usually, one week. We did a Rhine cruise for our twenty-fifth and I loved it, which I didn't expect. What about you?
Usman: Mostly Lahore, to see my parents, once a year. And two years ago my wife and I did Umrah, in Mecca. That was the most important trip, for me.
Karen: I can imagine. I'm Church of England, I don't go every week, but I know what you mean about some things mattering more than a beach.
Usman: Yes. Exactly. The beach is nice, but
